_how: Each outcome has one or more measures. 'target' is the number to meet ('better' says whether lower or higher meets it); leave it null where the target is still to be agreed. A measure's 'from' is a dashboard figure (for example soc.mtta_minutes), 'kql' is a Sentinel query returning one row with a 'value' column, and 'manual' is a value you type. 'status' is the declared programme status (Projected or Realised). 'sample' is shown until a live value exists. Copy to the data folder as outcomes.json to edit.
title: SOC, SIEM and SOAR Phase 2 outcomes

measures.label: Resolve a P1
measures.kql: SecurityIncident | where TimeGenerated > ago(30d) | summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by IncidentNumber | where Status == 'Closed' and Severity == 'High' | summarize value = round(percentile(datetime_diff('minute', ClosedTime, CreatedTime), 50) / 60.0, 1)
measures.note: P1 is taken as a closed High-severity incident; change the query if your priorities are tagged differently.

measures.label: Resolve a P2
measures.kql: SecurityIncident | where TimeGenerated > ago(30d) | summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by IncidentNumber | where Status == 'Closed' and Severity == 'Medium' | summarize value = round(percentile(datetime_diff('minute', ClosedTime, CreatedTime), 50) / 60.0, 1)

measures.label: Median containment
measures.kql: SecurityIncident | where TimeGenerated > ago(30d) | summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by IncidentNumber | where Status == 'Closed' | summarize value = round(percentile(datetime_diff('minute', ClosedTime, CreatedTime), 50) / 60.0, 1)
measures.note: Uses time to close until the SOC records a containment time.

measures.label: Tier-1 systems monitored
measures.note: Enter from the Tier-1 asset register until it is tagged in Sentinel.

outcomes.outcome: Managed service runs EDR and email security, freeing internal teams

measures.label: Log ingestion per day
measures.kql: Usage | where TimeGenerated > ago(7d) and IsBillable == true | summarize value = round(sum(Quantity) / 1024 / 7, 0)

measures.label: High-value log sources in the SIEM
measures.kql: Usage | where TimeGenerated > ago(7d) and IsBillable == true | summarize value = dcount(DataType)
measures.note: Counts billable data types in the workspace. Set the target once agreed.
